text.p: Average yields at auctions of Ukrainian six-month, nine-month, 12-month and 18-month treasury bills were down from the last sales, a central bank statement said on Tuesday.

Six-month bills eased to 19.91 percent from 19.93 percent, nine-month bills fell to 24.60 percent from 25.39 percent, 12-month bills edged down to 24.76 percent from 26.02 percent, and 18-month bills fell to 27.30 from 28.69 percent.
The results of the six-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 12.60 million UAH 12.60 million UAH
Amount sold 10.22 million UAH 8.36 million UAH
Actual amount raised 9.29 million UAH 7.60 million UAH
The central bank sold 102,221 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills has not been announced.
The results of the nine-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 11.00 million UAH 32.00 million UAH
Amount sold 11.00 million UAH 32.00 million UAH
Actual amount raised 9.29 million UAH 26.89 million UAH
The central bank sold 110,000 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of nine-month discount T-bills has not been announced.
The results of the 12-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 26.60 million UAH 45.40 million UAH
Amount sold 26.60 million UAH 45.40 million UAH
Actual amount raised 21.33 million UAH 36.04 million UAH
The central bank sold 266,000 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of 12-month discount T-bills was not announced.
The results of the 18-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 6.80 million UAH 37.00 million UAH
Amount sold 6.80 million UAH 37.00 million UAH
Actual amount raised 4.82 million UAH 25.88 million UAH
The central bank sold 68,000 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of 18-month discount T-bills has not been announced.
